name: Water Heater Rebate
description: Up to $4,000 rebate for replacing a gas water heater with an electric heat pump water heater (limited-time through Oct. 31, 2026), $500 for replacing an electric water heater, plus $1,000 for CARE/FERA customers and $1,000 for electrical panel upgrade
fullDescription: WestLight Energy (formerly Peninsula Clean Energy) offers substantial rebates for San Mateo County and Los Banos homeowners to replace gas or electric water heaters with efficient heat pump water heaters.
whatTheyOffer:
- Up to $4,000 for a heat pump water heater replacing a gas water heater (limited-time offer for installs Sept. 1 to Oct. 31, 2026)
- $500 rebate for replacing electric resistance water heater
- Additional $1,000 for CARE/FERA customers
- Additional $1,000 for electrical panel upgrade
- Up to $500 each for smart load management devices
- Can combine with zero-interest loan program and other incentives
howToGetIt:
1. Must be a WestLight Energy customer and the legal owner of the property
2. Hire any contractor (self-installs also qualify) and get the required city permit
3. Take photos of your old water heater before it is replaced
4. Complete installation
5. Submit rebate application with itemized invoice, photos, and permit within 90 days
6. Optional: Apply for zero-interest loan (before installation, with an approved contractor)
keywords: water heater, heat pump, rebate, WestLight Energy, Peninsula Clean Energy, PCE, San Mateo, gas replacement, electrification, hot water
